rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin (spot)
positions.catalyst: Weekend session (US equity & leveraged-ETF markets closed) — spot crypto is the only tradable universe. Tape has turned mildly constructive vs Saturday: total crypto market cap ~$2.2T, +0.65% 24h. Fresh BTC-specific catalyst: White House confirmed setup of an official US strategic Bitcoin reserve (sector +9.28%), and SEC/CFTC clarity that 16 major coins aren't securities lifted digital-commodities sentiment +9.12%. BTC ~$64,432 (firm, near $1.26T cap).
positions.driver: LONG BTC spot — the reserve-confirmation headline is a genuine fresh BTC-specific bullish catalyst, and BTC remains the deepest-liquidity, lowest-vol crypto = best downside protection for a 100% weekend hold. Chose BTC over ETH ($1,884.72; higher beta, its ETF/staking catalyst is being worked in the separate crypto book, no incremental edge here at 100% size) and over SOL ($74.91; laggard/highest-vol, no fresh long catalyst — a short candidate, but inverse/leveraged instruments are unavailable on weekends). Leverage N/A (weekend spot only). Hard stop 57,988.90 (-10% spot-crypto rule).
positions.risks: Crypto trades 24/7 so a weekend headline (regulatory reversal / macro / liquidation cascade) can move BTC hard with no equity-hours circuit breaker. All-in single asset = no diversification. Reserve/regulatory catalysts are narrative-driven and could fade into Monday.
